topics.title: Bathtub Scene Dubbing Mishaps
topics.summary: During a radio segment, hosts discuss the re-insertion of a bathtub scene featuring Tony Curtis and Sir Laurence Olivier with dubbed audio by Anthony Hopkins (voicing Olivier) and Brent. A viewer was ejected after attempting to interview celebrities in the rain.

topics.title: Stuttering Debate & Porky Pig
topics.summary: Participants discuss calibration issues while transitioning to a debate about blaming Jewish people for historical events. They then introduce national stuttering month advocating for banning Porky Pig due to its perceived encouragement of mockery of those who stutter.

topics.title: Stuttering Exchange and Questions
topics.summary: The broadcast features a series of exchanges marked by frequent stuttering, questions about Jewish identity, and references to rain-soaked notes. Participants discuss awkward encounters with Ted Kennedy while attempting to clarify the meaning of 'tape for broadcast,' leading to confusion.

topics.title: Lost Interview Questions
topics.summary: During a television interview, the guest and interviewer struggle with misplaced question sheets while discussing Merv Griffin, inappropriate comments about sexuality, and accusations of antisemitism; they attempt to retrieve lost questions.

topics.title: Off-Topic Discussions and Movie Mentions
topics.summary: The broadcast features a series of unrelated conversations including sexually suggestive questions about actors Tony Curtis and Marilyn Monroe, references to the movie "King of New York," and recollections of past radio segments alongside commentary on listener mail regarding college tuition costs.

topics.title: College Tuition and Breakfast
topics.summary: A speaker expresses frustration over wasted college tuition for a student unable to learn basic vocabulary, suggesting corporal punishment for teachers. The conversation then shifts to promoting NutriSystem with an emphasis on breakfast options and meal plans.
